svg.title: Grand Theft Code theme in T3 Code
svg.desc: Animated mock-up of the T3 Code window with the Grand Theft Code theme: a sidebar of threads, a chat where an agent installs the theme, and a sunset background with palms and a VI badge.

g.text: The theme file is in your themes folder and T3 Code has switched to it.
Palms sway, clouds drift and a plane crosses the sky every 75 seconds.
badge floats in the corner. Ask for the clean variant to drop it.
